# A reading against the share does not ratchet

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`a-reading-against-the-share-does-not-ratchet` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](a-reading-against-the-share-does-not-ratchet.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where the rule is read against the share and selection under a favouring rule does not lower the share, along a course whose rules favour the rule read at a later reading step is not above the rule read at an earlier one: the rise the lock rests on does not form.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Along a course whose rules favour, the share falls at no stretch; read against the share, the rule read later is not above the rule read earlier. (`Becoming.RuleCapture.share_kept_along`, `Becoming.RuleCapture.against_not_rising`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; selection under a favouring rule does not lower the share; the rule read against the share (the reading monotone into the reversed order); rules favouring along the course.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That a course read against the share is never locked at a step, or that its share falls.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
